title: Morris White's perfect tempo and his marriage to W.C. Handy's daughter
summary: The band tests guitarist Morris White's time against a metronome and he passes; he married Handy's youngest daughter Lil.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: named Prince. And Morris White was the guitar player. Now, there's a funny thing about Morris. We used to... You know, drummers have a tendency to pick up tempo. And we got in an argument one day, and Morris said, " I don't lose no tempos."
He didn't. We checked him out with the metronome. We checked him out with the metronome, and he started...
He was most perfect rhythm player I played with.

He started with a beat, and we stopped the metronome and let him play a while, and after he played a while, we put the metronome back on, and he was right in time with it. He married Handy's younger daughter. He was kind of a handsome little cat. I knew his brother very well.
No, not Catherine. I forget her name. She passed on. Lil. Lil Handy. She was the youngest. She was the prettiest, too.
